reading_log.notes: Read complete motivation, comparisons, actual maximum-cardinality graph definitions, SAT decision semantics, reduction-based reuse of one MIS model, full pipeline and supervised network setup.

Read all network/hindsight loss, random-queue tree search and reduction/local-search details, complete data/train/test protocols, 20-layer 32-map model and main SAT tables. Same trained MIS model reused across reductions; 16-thread versus 16-times baseline time accounting.

Read every remaining result/ablation/table/figure caption, conclusion and references 1-39. Main claim of social-graph optimality is explicitly conjectural; large-clique complement failure and local-search contribution recorded.

Read complete official ZIP supplement: exact task reductions, all three algorithms, 2-improvement and four reduction rules, all real-graph stats, width ablation and references. Heuristic failure to reach clause count cannot certify UNSAT.

claims.statement: Multiple incompatible optimum labels can blur one membership map.
A 32-map supervised GCN and hindsight loss guide randomized queue tree search.
The same SATLIB-trained MIS network is used for all tasks via explicit MIS reductions.

claims.statement: All SATLIB test formulas are solved; Z3 has the same fraction and much lower median time.

16-thread tree search uses a different wall-clock allowance from 16-times-time continuing baselines; training takes about 16 hours on the stated CPU/GPU.
